command: rtk proxy devenv shell -- rtk proxy cargo test --locked --offline --manifest-path desktop/gpui/Cargo.toml --features ui-tests --bin twyne-desktop app::note_coordinator::tests::saved_unblurred_note_stays_clean_after_queued_changes_but_new_edits_are_dirty -- --exact --test-threads=1

before.assertion: An accepted note must stay saved

cause: Save accepted the live note revision before its queued Changed event reached the host, which then marked the saved document dirty again.
correction: The current rich editor's Changed event is ignored when its revision is already included in the last accepted save.
checks: The saved Unicode note stays clean after queued subscriptions settle.
The accepted document revision and durable bytes remain unchanged.
The footer reports Saved locally and the retained note input stays focused.
A newer rich edit still advances the document revision and schedules save.
boundary: Mounted GPUI test-platform proof; actual X11 acceptance is recorded separately.
